items.title: B. Reactions involving replacement of -OH group (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: B. Reactions involving replacement of -OH group: a main subheading of 23.5 Reactions of Carboxylic Acids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 110-110.

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids substitution reactions (aik group ki jagah doosra group aana) kar sakte hain jin mein OH group ki jagah koi aur group, jaise X (halogen), OR ya NH₂, aa jata hai.
a) SOCl₂, PCl₃ aur PCl₅ ke saath (acyl chloride banta hai)

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Kitab heading mein PCl₃ ka naam leti hai lekin us ki equation nahi deti. PCl₃ ke saath garam karne par bhi acyl chloride banta hai: 3CH₃COOH + PCl₃ → 3CH₃COCl + H₃PO₃.
Carboxylic acids ko concentrated sulphuric acid ki presence (maujoodgi) mein alcohols ke saath garam karne se esters bante hain.

blocks.text_alt: CH₃–COOH (ethanoic acid) + C₂H₅OH (ethanol) ⇌ CH₃–COOC₂H₅ (ethyl ethanoate) + H₂O (H₂SO₄)
